info.name: AppFinder public API
info.description: Search, compare and inspect software listings. No key. Keep source attribution. API terms: https://appfinder.tech/terms#api

item.name: Search listed apps by what they do. Most relevant first.

request.description: Use slugs from current search results. Examples may change as listings change.

exec: pm.test('Source attribution retained', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('data'); pm.expect(body.meta.source).to.eql('AppFinder'); });
